di = pd.read_csv(\"device_inventory.csv\")

outs = di[di[\"txn_type\"]==\"OUT\"]
print(\"\\nOUT txns:\", len(outs))
print(outs[[\"device_type\",\"qty\",\"reference\"]].to_string())
EOF"

/bin/sh -lc "cd /work && python - <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd

bm = pd.read_excel(\"beneficiary_master.xlsx\")
di = pd.read_csv(\"device_inventory.csv\")

outs = di[di[\"txn_type\"]==\"OUT\"].copy()
outs[\"ref_name\"] = outs[\"reference\"].str.replace(\"Issued to \", \"\", regex=False)

# any OUT reference name present in the master?
overlap = set(outs[\"ref_name\"]) & set(bm[\"Name\"])
print(\"OUT ref names:\", outs[\"ref_name\"].nunique(), \"of\", len(outs))
print(\"names overlapping with master:\", len(overlap), sorted(overlap)[:10])

# devices per beneficiary in master
issued = bm[bm[\"Assistive Device Issued\"].notna()]
print(\"beneficiaries with device:\", len(issued))

# cross-check: sum of OUT qty vs master device counts
print(\"\\nMaster device counts:\\n\", issued[\"Assistive Device Issued\"].value_counts().to_string())
print(\"\\nOUT qty per device type:\\n\", outs.groupby(\"device_type\")[\"qty\"].sum().to_string())

# duplicate beneficiaries in OUT refs?
dup_names = outs[\"ref_name\"].value_counts()
print(\"\\nduplicate names in OUT refs:\", (dup_names>1).sum())

# date sanity: issue dates in master
print(\"\\nissue date nulls among issued:\", issued[\"Device Issue Date\"].isna().sum())
EOF"

**How the data resolves**

The `beneficiary_master.xlsx` (210 unique beneficiaries) is the per-beneficiary record: 143 rows have a non-null `Assistive Device Issued` with a matching `Device Issue Date` (fully consistent, no orphaned values, no duplicate UDIDs). The `device_inventory.csv` is a stock ledger (IN/OUT quantities); its "Issued to …" references only partially overlap with the master (15 of 166 names), so it can't serve as the beneficiary count — the master is the authoritative source.

| Total beneficiaries in master | 210 |
| Beneficiaries who received an assistive device | **143** |
| Breakdown: Calipers 25, Crutches 24, Wheelchair 23, Tricycle 20, Braille kit 19, Walking stick 18, Hearing aid 14 | — |
